clauses.heading: Bid Details
clauses.quote: Minimum Average Annual Turnover of the bidder (For 3 Years) 60 Lakh (s)
clauses.summary: Bidder must have a minimum average annual turnover of Rs 60 lakh over 3 years.

clauses.heading: Bid Details
clauses.quote: OEM Average Turnover (Last 3 Years) 120 Lakh (s) Bid Details
clauses.summary: OEM of the offered product must have an average turnover of Rs 120 lakh over the last 3 years.

clauses.heading: Bid Details
clauses.quote: Years of Past Experience Required for same/similar service 3 Year (s)
clauses.summary: Bidder must have 3 years of past experience in same or similar supply.

clauses.heading: Bid Details
clauses.quote: MSE Relaxation for Years of Experience and Turnover No /Startup Relaxation for Years of Experience and Turnover No
clauses.summary: No MSE or startup relaxation is allowed for turnover criteria.

clauses.heading: Bid Details
clauses.quote: MSE Relaxation for Years of Experience and Turnover No /Startup Relaxation for Years of Experience and Turnover No
clauses.summary: No MSE or startup relaxation is allowed for experience criteria.

clauses.heading: Bid Details
clauses.quote: Document required from seller Experience Criteria,Past Performance,Bidder Turnover,Certificate (Requested in ATC),OEM Authorization Certificate,OEM Annual Turnover
clauses.summary: Seller must upload experience, past performance, bidder turnover, OEM authorization and OEM turnover documents.

clauses.heading: EMD Detail
clauses.quote: Advisory Bank State Bank of India /EMD Amount 364542
clauses.summary: An EMD of Rs 3,64,542 is required.

clauses.heading: EMD EXEMPTION
clauses.quote: Under MSE category, only manufacturers for goods and Service Providers for Services are eligible for exemption from EMD. Traders are excluded from the purview of this Policy.
clauses.summary: EMD exemption for MSEs is limited to manufacturers and service providers; traders are excluded.

clauses.heading: EMD EXEMPTION
clauses.quote: The bidder seeking EMD exemption, must submit the valid supporting document for the relevant category as per GeM GTC with the bid.
clauses.summary: Bidders claiming EMD exemption must upload valid supporting documents with the bid.

clauses.quote: Documentary evidence in the form of certified Audited Balance Sheets of relevant periods or a certificate from the Chartered Accountant / Cost Accountant indicating the turnover details for the relevant period shall be uploaded with the bid.
clauses.summary: Turnover must be proven with audited balance sheets or a CA/Cost Accountant certificate.

clauses.heading: 2. Experience Criteria
clauses.quote: the Bidder or its OEM of the product offered in the bid {themselves or through reseller(s)} should have regularly, manufactured and supplied same or similar Category Products to any Central / State Govt Organization / PSU
clauses.summary: Bidder or its OEM must have regularly supplied similar products to government bodies or PSUs for the required years.

clauses.heading: 3. OEM Turn Over Criteria
clauses.quote: The minimum average annual financial turnover of the OEM of the offered product during the last three years, ending on 31st March of the previous financial year, should be as indicated in the bid document.
clauses.summary: OEM must meet the minimum average annual turnover stated in the bid over the last three years.

clauses.heading: 6. Past Performance
clauses.quote: The Bidder or its OEM {themselves or through re-seller(s)} should have supplied same or similar Category Products for 80% of bid quantity, in at least one of the last three Financial years
clauses.summary: Bidder or OEM must have supplied 80% of the bid quantity in one of the last three financial years to government bodies or PSUs.

clauses.heading: 11. Buyer Added Bid Specific ATC
clauses.quote: the bidders are required to submit EMD of Rs.3,64,542/- in favour of The R egistrar, GGSIP University in the form of Demand Draft / NEFT/RTGS.
clauses.summary: Bidders must submit an EMD of Rs 3,64,542 by DD or NEFT/RTGS to the Registrar, GGSIP University.

clauses.quote: A Bid speciﬁc MAF issued by OEM is required only for Core Switc h, Distribution Switch, Access Switch and Network Management Soft ware to be uploaded.
clauses.summary: A bid-specific OEM authorisation (MAF) must be uploaded for the switches and network management software.

clauses.heading: 26 Generic
clauses.quote: should have regularly, manufactured and supplied same or similar Category Products to any Central / State Govt Organization / PSU for 3 years before the bid opening date.
clauses.summary: Bidder or OEM must have supplied similar products to government bodies or PSUs for 3 years before bid opening.

clauses.heading: 31 Generic
clauses.quote: Manufacturer Authorization: Wherever Authorised Distributors/service providers are submitting the bid, Authorisation Form /Certificate with OEM/Original Service Provider details such as name, designation, address, e-mail Id and Phone No. required to be furnished along with the bid
clauses.summary: Distributors bidding must furnish an OEM authorisation certificate with OEM contact details.
